passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My mom is my favorite person.
phrases.py: mā mā shì wǒ zuì xǐ huān de rén。

phrases.en: I spend time with her, and we laugh a lot.
phrases.ko: 나는 엄마와 시간을 보내고, 우리는 많이 웃어요.
phrases.zh: 我和她一起度过时间，我们常常笑。
phrases.py: wǒ hé tā yì qǐ dù guò shí jiān， wǒ men cháng cháng xiào。

phrases.zh: 和她在一起，我觉得安全。
phrases.py: hé tā zài yì qǐ， wǒ jué de ān quán。
tā duì wǒ lái shuō hěn tè bié。

phrases.en: I love her because she cares for me.
phrases.ko: 엄마가 나를 돌봐 주기 때문에 나는 엄마를 사랑해요.
phrases.py: wǒ ài tā， yīn wèi tā zhào gù wǒ。

phrases.en: A favorite person knows your heart.
phrases.ko: 가장 좋아하는 사람은 내 마음을 알아요.
phrases.zh: 最喜欢的人懂得你的心。
phrases.py: zuì xǐ huān de rén dǒng de nǐ de xīn。

phrases.en: We spend time in the kitchen after school.
phrases.ko: 우리는 방과 후에 부엌에서 시간을 보내요.
phrases.zh: 放学后我们在厨房里一起度过时间。
phrases.py: fàng xué hòu wǒ men zài chú fáng lǐ yì qǐ dù guò shí jiān。

phrases.en: She laughs when I tell a small story.
phrases.ko: 내가 짧은 이야기를 하면 엄마가 웃어요.
phrases.zh: 我讲一个小故事，她就会笑。
phrases.py: wǒ jiǎng yí gè xiǎo gù shì， tā jiù huì xiào。

phrases.en: I feel safe because her voice is warm.
phrases.zh: 她的声音很温暖，所以我觉得安全。
phrases.py: tā de shēng yīn hěn wēn nuǎn， suǒ yǐ wǒ jué de ān quán。

phrases.en: She is special because she never gives up on me.
phrases.zh: 她从不放弃我，所以很特别。
phrases.py: tā cóng bù fàng qì wǒ， suǒ yǐ hěn tè bié。

phrases.en: I love this person every day.
phrases.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu ài zhè ge rén。

full_passage_spoken: My mom is my favorite person. I spend time with her, and we laugh a lot. I feel safe with her. She is special to me. I love her because she cares for me. A favorite person knows your heart. We spend time in the kitchen after school. She laughs when I tell a small story. I feel safe because her voice is warm. She is special because she never gives up on me. I love this person every day.
topic_pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de rén
full_passage_zh: 妈妈是我最喜欢的人。我和她一起度过时间，我们常常笑。和她在一起，我觉得安全。她对我来说很特别。我爱她，因为她照顾我。最喜欢的人懂得你的心。放学后我们在厨房里一起度过时间。我讲一个小故事，她就会笑。她的声音很温暖，所以我觉得安全。她从不放弃我，所以很特别。我每天都爱这个人。
